reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "[middleware] Disable Content-Type auto-detection by default (#9546 by sdelicata)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Middleware that previously applied Content-Type auto-detection by default will no longer do so; explicit configuration is required to restore the previous behavior.
consequence.remediation: Review middleware configurations using Content-Type auto-detection and explicitly enable it if the previous behavior is required.

proposed.statement: Content-Type auto-detection in Traefik middleware is now disabled by default.
